summary: Master payment fraud detection and prevention with practical controls, analytics, and reporting. Build fraud-ready workflows and strengthen payment governance.
lede: Payment fraud detection training helps finance, payment, audit, and compliance professionals identify suspicious activity. It addresses the practical work of reviewing transactions and escalating risk through anomaly screening, approval design, vendor verification, and investigation evidence handling. Learners also explore dashboard alert triage and monitoring across card, ACH, wire, and digital payment flows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work in payment operations, fraud review, audit, treasury, finance control, procurement, and compliance roles and need stronger methods for detecting and preventing payment fraud.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software and access to a calculator or analytics worksheet. A working knowledge of payment workflows, vendor setup, approval processes, and fraud review terminology will help you complete the exercises more efficiently. If your organisation uses ERP or treasury systems, you may also bring sample payment reports, exception logs, or control documentation for reference.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
